items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Said, 'Tell Baby Davey sorry, we can't use him.' And Baby Davey being alcoholic, too, he went back to Kansas City and committed suicide.

ctx.x: Yes. The next week I get another wire, come back for another date.

Now, the first date, it's a collector's item. Just a blues, a blues in two part. Said, "Tell Baby Davey sorry, we can't use him." And Baby Davey being alcoholic, too, he went back to Kansas City and committed suicide.
